//: TODO(design): the Order of the Eternal Flame on the map (GAME_DESIGN.md §5.5, §8; M3). Working values and texts by Claude; change them freely. The Order comes down through the Passages to the surface (and the Old Workings shaft) and moves in the world turn, after End Turn. Movement is in movement points, with the same terrain costs as the hydra's. sight: how far a patrol sees the hydra, in hexes.

alertStages.text: Bells in the chapter house. The Order doubles its patrols and tells them to look under things.
The Order is raising an expedition against the lair. Somebody has been made to count the torches.
Crossbowmen, knights and a tithe collector come down from the castle. The tithe collector has brought his own ledger.
The Great Burning is declared. A Master of the Order is coming to the lair, with everyone he could find.

patrols.//: How many patrols walk the underground at once, and how often a new one comes down, by the number of Alert stages reached (first number: none reached yet). In act 2 and later, actMaxBonus more at once. A patrol walks from chamber to chamber; one that sees the hydra follows her for chaseTurns world turns after losing sight of her. groups: encounter groups from enemies.json, by weight; minRing: only from an entrance in this ring or deeper; fromStage: only once this Alert stage is reached (or in act 2 and later).
patrols.arrived: A patrol of the Order comes down from the surface, with lanterns and a list.

messengers.//: After every battle the Order hears of (not near the Silent Bell), a messenger runs for the nearest Passage, headStart hexes ahead. If he gets there, the Alert rises by alertOnArrival. Stepping onto his hex eats him: bones, and the Alert changes by alertWhenEaten. eatenLines: one of them is said when he is eaten.
messengers.sent: Someone got away from the fight and is running for the Passage, to tell the Order. Catch him first.
messengers.escaped: The messenger reached the Passage. The chapter house will hear of this by supper.
eatenLines: The messenger is eaten, satchel and all. One head reads the letter. It was mostly about us, and not kind.
Caught. His letter said: monster in the deep, send help. It no longer says anything.
The messenger is eaten. Somewhere a chapter house waits for news, and gets none.
Swallowed mid-prayer. The heads agree he was running the wrong way anyway.

expeditions.//: From the Alert stage fromStage on, an expedition sets out for the lair every everyTurns world turns, one at a time, from the entrance furthest from the lair that has a way to it. groups: encounter groups from enemies.json, by weight.
expeditions.sent: An expedition of the Order sets out for the lair, with a cart of firewood and a hymn.

greatBurning.//: At the Alert stage atStage, once per act, the Great Burning sets out for the lair: a Master of the Order with his procession (group, from enemies.json). Beaten, the Master is eaten, and the hydra gets one of mutations (mutations.json) she doesn't carry yet, at random.
greatBurning.sent: The Great Burning comes down to the lair: a Master of the Order, carried, and everyone who could be spared, walking.
greatBurning.beaten: The Master is eaten. The Order will need a while to choose a new one, and longer to forgive. Act {act} begins.

tithe.//: A Tithe Collector who gets away from a battle takes percent of each of the hydra's resources (rounded down), and leaves a receipt. {list}: what he took.
tithe.taken: The Tithe Collector got away with {list}.
tithe.nothing: nothing at all, which he wrote down
tithe.receipt: He left a receipt: "Received of the beast in the swamp, for the upkeep of the Eternal Flame. With thanks. No refunds."

siege.//: An expedition that finds the lair empty camps in it: every world turn it kills perTurn Broodlings guarding it, or, when none is left, breaks as many eggs.
siege.killedDefender: The Order is camped in the lair. A Broodling guarding it was killed.
siege.brokeEgg: The Order is camped in the lair. An egg was broken, and the shell entered into the record.
